```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
print(open_dataset("data/history.parquet")$schema)

markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
history <- read_parquet("data/history.parquet")

glimpse(groups)
print(head(groups, 3))
cat("Rows in groups:", nrow(groups), "\n")

glimpse(market_groups)
print(head(market_groups, 3))
cat("Rows in market_groups:", nrow(market_groups), "\n")

print(head(markets |> select(market_id, group_slugs), 3))

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric)
  )

cat("Rows in joined:", nrow(joined), "\n")

joined |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    median_absolute_error = median(absolute_error)
  )
```
